entries.title: Teardown
entries.definitive_edition: Teardown on Windows PC with current updates and optional Ultimate Edition/Season Pass DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC settings and mod support.

primary.version: Current PC release / Ultimate Edition content as desired
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the native PC release, the broad Steam Workshop/custom-content path, and the PC-first multiplayer update path, while the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions do not have platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Teardown on Steam for Windows PC, install the current build, and add the Season Pass/Ultimate Edition DLC if you want the complete paid expansion set.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; the main caveat is edition choice, because paid DLC/Season Pass content is separate from the base campaign.
